name: English
about: Source catalog. Every other language file in this folder translates these keys. 'note' tells the translator what the string is and where it shows. 'max' is the longest translation that fits, in characters of an alphabetic script (Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Thai, Devanagari); 'maxWide' is the same limit for full-width scripts (Chinese, Japanese, Korean). The English text of the hud.* keys is drawn by the built-in glyph table, not from this file; it is listed here as the source to translate from.

hud.dlss_upscaling.note: Upscaling by DLSS Super Resolution or by the unified Ray Reconstruction pass.

hud.unavailable.note: Feature is unavailable on this system; short status badge.

blimp.bloomLate.note: Short illuminated slogan on one side of the Taipei airship. An orchid blooms late, after dark.

blimp.stayWild.note: Short illuminated slogan on the other side of the airship. Keep a wild, independent spirit.

cap.01.text: MEI-LIN: XINYI RAIN ON GLASS... KEEP YOUR EYES UP, IRIS.
cap.01.note: Subtitle. Family edition, opening. Mei-Lin, a Taipei field agent, speaks to her partner Dr. Iris. Xinyi is a Taipei district. Playful spy-noir tone.

cap.02.text: DR. IRIS: NOT SKYSCRAPERS - HYDROXYAPATITE ENAMEL PRISMS!
cap.02.note: Subtitle. Family edition. The reveal: the 'city' is tooth enamel seen under a microscope. Hydroxyapatite is the mineral of enamel; use the standard scientific term.

cap.03.text: MEI-LIN: EIGHT MIRROR STELAE BOUNCING EVERY ORCHID CODE.
cap.03.note: Subtitle. Family edition. Eight mirrored standing stones reflect the secret 'orchid' signal. Stelae = upright stone slabs.

cap.04.text: DR. IRIS: LIVING BIOFILM RHYTHMS... FRIEND OR TROUBLE?
cap.04.note: Subtitle. Family edition. Biofilm = the bacterial film on teeth (dental plaque). She wonders if it is friendly.

cap.05.text: MADAME N: WELCOME! PLEASE DO NOT ZAP MY TINY RESIDENTS.
cap.05.note: Subtitle. Family edition. Madame N is a grand, warm hostess who protects the mouth's microbes ('tiny residents'). Zap = destroy, said lightly.

cap.06.text: MADAME N: BENEFICIAL MICROBES! PROTECT BALANCE, NOT ZERO.
cap.06.note: Subtitle. Family edition. The point: a healthy mouth keeps its microbes in balance; the goal is not zero microbes.

cap.07.text: DR. IRIS: TORONTO PLAQUE TOWERS TO NEW ORLEANS BRASS!
cap.07.note: Subtitle. Family edition. A fast montage of cities: from towers of dental plaque styled like Toronto to a New Orleans brass band. Excited tone.

cap.08.text: MEI-LIN: BUFFERING SPRINGS AND MINERAL COASTS IN MOTION!
cap.08.note: Subtitle. Family edition. Saliva is pictured as springs that buffer acid, and minerals as coastlines. Buffering is the chemistry sense (neutralising acid).

cap.09.text: MEI-LIN: SIGNAL HIJACK! EVEN COMPRESSED, THE ORCHID HOLDS.
cap.09.note: Subtitle. Family edition. The video signal is hijacked and shown heavily compressed; the orchid image still survives.

cap.10.text: MADAME N: ALL ENGINES TOGETHER! GRAND GLASS ORCHID BLOOM!
cap.10.note: Subtitle. Family edition, finale. 'Engines' are the PC's graphics engines playing together like an orchestra; a huge glass orchid blooms.

cap.11.text: MEI-LIN: JUST MORNING LIGHT, A MIRROR, AND GENTLE CARE.
cap.11.note: Subtitle. Family edition, last line. Quiet and warm: the adventure ends at an ordinary bathroom mirror, brushing teeth in the morning.

cap.12.text: MEI-LIN: RAIN, NEON, AND LATE COFFEE WITH YOU, DR. LIN.
cap.12.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition (more grown-up, flirtatious noir), opening. Dr. Lin is Dr. Iris Lin, her partner.

cap.13.text: DR. IRIS: A WHOLE CITY CARVED IN MINERAL ENAMEL, MEI-LIN.
cap.13.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. The reveal that the city is tooth enamel.

cap.14.text: MEI-LIN: CAREFUL IN THE MIRRORS - SECRETS DOUBLE IN GLASS.
cap.14.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. Noir line in a hall of mirrors.

cap.15.text: DR. IRIS: VELVET CAUSTICS ALONG THE MARGIN. WHO RUNS THIS?
cap.15.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. Caustics = rippling patterns of focused light. The margin is the gum line. She asks who is in charge here.

cap.16.text: MADAME N: DARLINGS, PUT AWAY ROUGH HABITS. LISTEN CLOSELY.
cap.16.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. Madame N, theatrical and commanding, tells them to be gentle (rough habits = harsh brushing).

cap.17.text: MADAME N: GOOD FLORA KEEP THE PEACE. ECOLOGY OVER EXCESS.
cap.17.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. Flora = the mouth's helpful microbes. Balance matters more than overdoing it.

cap.18.text: DR. IRIS: FIVE CITIES IN ONE BREATH - PH NEAR 5.5 DRIFT.
cap.18.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. pH is the acidity measure; around 5.5 enamel starts to dissolve. Keep 'pH' and '5.5' (use the local decimal mark).

cap.19.text: MEI-LIN: SALIVA BUFFERS, FLUORIDE HELPS REMINERALIZE.
cap.19.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. Plain science: saliva neutralises acid, fluoride helps enamel regain minerals. Use standard dental terms.

cap.20.text: MEI-LIN: STATIC ON THE BAY CHANNEL... OUR SIGNAL SURVIVES.
cap.20.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition. Radio static on a channel by the bay; their transmission gets through.

cap.21.text: MADAME N: EVERY INSTRUMENT IN HARMONY. ONE LAST DANCE.
cap.21.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition, finale. Orchestra metaphor for the PC's engines.

cap.22.text: DR. IRIS: DAWN AT THE VANITY MIRROR. SEE YOU TONIGHT.
cap.22.note: Subtitle. Midnight edition, last line. Vanity mirror = bathroom mirror. Tender goodbye.

cap.23.text: A CELEBRATION OF ORAL CARE - NOT MEDICAL ADVICE.
cap.23.note: End card shown over the closing title. A plain disclaimer: this film celebrates dental care and is not medical advice. Must be clear and literal.

hud.prev.note: Button: previous scene. An arrow is drawn beside it.

hud.next.note: Button: next scene. An arrow is drawn beside it.

hud.mode_film.note: Button showing the camera mode: the film plays on its authored camera. Keep the 'F:' prefix exactly; F is the keyboard key.

hud.mode_free.note: Button showing the camera mode: the viewer moves the camera freely. Keep the 'F:' prefix exactly.

hud.hardware.note: Heading of a table showing active GPU and NPU workloads.

hud.col_size.note: Column heading: size of the workload.

hud.state_live.note: Status badge: this engine is running on real hardware now.

hud.state_sub.note: Status badge: a substitute (software stand-in) is running because the hardware is not available. Abbreviate 'substitute'.

hud.state_off.note: Status badge: this engine is switched off.

hud.state_fault.note: Status badge: this engine failed (fault / error). Abbreviate.

hud.state_script.note: The stage director is using its scripted fallback.

hud.state_warming.note: The stage director is preparing the model for inference.

hud.state_idle.note: The codec has no work this frame and can run when a cue or comparison requests it.

hud.bench.note: Heading of the benchmark results card. Keep ' [B]' exactly; B is the keyboard key.

hud.cam_free.note: Toggle label: free camera is on.

hud.cam_film.note: Toggle label: film camera is on.

hud.lamp.note: Toggle: the lamps in the scene on or off.

hud.wipe.note: Toggle: a split-screen before/after comparison with a draggable divider.

hud.marbles.note: Toggle: drop glass marbles into the scene. Abbreviate 'marbles'.

hud.sun.note: Slider label: height of the sun.

hud.azimuth.note: Slider label: compass direction of the sun (azimuth). Abbreviate.

hud.music.note: Button state: music is playing. Abbreviate 'music'.

hud.reset.note: Button: reset the lighting controls. Abbreviate 'reset'.

hud.next_scene.note: Button: go to the next scene. An arrow is drawn beside it.

hud.solo.note: Label before the name of the one engine being shown alone, as in a music 'solo'. Keep the colon.

hud.all.note: Button: return to all engines together. Keep the square brackets.

hud.act.note: Current act of the film, as in a play. {n} becomes a number 1 to 7; keep {n}.

hud.scene.bathroom.note: Name of a scene: a bathroom.

hud.scene.faucet.note: Name of a scene: a water tap.

hud.scene.leaves.note: Name of a scene: plant leaves.

hud.scene.orchid.note: Name of a scene: the orchid flower.

hud.scene.enamel.note: Name of a scene: tooth enamel.

hud.scene.sanctuary.note: Name of a scene: a sanctuary (a sheltered sacred garden).

hud.scene.custom.note: Name shown when the viewer has set their own camera position.

hud.aov.albedo.note: Name of a debug view for 3D artists: base surface colour. Use the term 3D software uses in your language, or keep the English term if that is what artists use.

hud.aov.normal.note: Debug view: surface normals (direction a surface faces).

hud.aov.rough_metal.note: Debug view: roughness and metalness of surfaces. Two short words with a slash.

hud.aov.indirect.note: Debug view: indirect lighting (global illumination, GI).

hud.aov.ray_heat.note: Debug view: a heat map of how many light rays each pixel cost.

hud.live_camera.note: Privacy indicator shown beside a red dot whenever the webcam is on. Must be immediately clear.

hud.ost.synth.note: Now-playing notice: the built-in computer-generated synthesizer score. Keep RTX.

hud.ost.custom.note: Now-playing notice: the viewer's own music file. Keep 'MP3+'.

win.explore.note: Window title bar key hint: [F]=Explore (free camera).

win.wipe.note: Window title bar key hint: [H]=Wipe (split-screen comparison).

win.effects_detail.note: Window title next to key 7 and a detail level from 1 to 3.
